name: rescue-pr
summary: Repair a stuck pull request of Cloving: merge the default branch, fix the conflict, the failed CI or the review findings, then accept and merge it as in develop.

options.label: Greptile at 5/5
options.summary: Push the rescued branch and wait for Greptile to accept its commit at 5/5.
options.change: In rescue-pr/accept.ts call reviewByAgent({ subject: subject, reviewer: { kind: "greptile" } }). rescue-pr/round.ts pushes the branch first and passes its immutable commit and target as subject. Declare github wait-review.

options.label: A person
options.summary: Wait for a person's approval of the immutable commit. Denial with feedback starts another bounded rescue turn.
options.change: In rescue-pr/accept.ts replace the reviewByAgent import and call with reviewByPerson({ subject: subject }) from cloving/workflows/steps/review-by-person. Remove wait-review from methods.github in rescue-pr.declaration.json. Set selection.accept to person in rescue-pr/scenarios.ts.

options.label: A review turn
options.summary: Run the review profile and require its explicit accept verdict.
options.change: In rescue-pr/accept.ts call reviewByAgent({ subject: subject, reviewer: { kind: "turn", profile: "review" } }). In rescue-pr.declaration.json add run-turn:review to methods.claude, remove wait-review from methods.github, and configure the review profile. Set selection.accept to turn in rescue-pr/scenarios.ts.

options.label: Cloving after the checks
options.summary: Merge after acceptance, the beforeMerge check and CI. Give result.output to the next rescue turn on failure.
options.change: Keep mergeWhenGreen({ pull: pull, check: "beforeMerge", round: state.round }) after acceptance in rescue-pr/round.ts.

options.label: A person approves Cloving's merge
options.summary: Wait for merge approval, then run the beforeMerge check and CI before the merge.
options.change: In rescue-pr/round.ts replace the mergeWhenGreen import and call with mergeByPerson from cloving/workflows/steps/merge-by-person, with the same argument. Set selection.merge to person in rescue-pr/scenarios.ts.
